results.name: sql: average order value
results.text: The average order value, excluding cancelled orders, is **$1,345.55**. This value is calculated by summing the revenue from all orders that are not cancelled and dividing by the number of such orders.

input.sql: SELECT AVG(revenue) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id WHERE orders.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY orders.id) AS order_revenues;

input.sql: SELECT SUM(total_revenue) / COUNT(*) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT orders.id as order_id, SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id WHERE orders.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY orders.id) AS order_revenue;
